d: In this video, Firstpost explains Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to the top job after an 11-day absence. His comeback has sparked a wave of reactions and memes across social media, with users joking about his brief disappearance and speculating about what happened. From comparisons to a dramatic comeback to jokes about taking a break for GTA 6, the internet has turned Huang's return into a viral moment. We look at the online buzz surrounding the Nvidia chief and why his return has captured the internet's attention. Hem Kaur Saroya brings you all the details on Vantage on Firstpost.
